entities.name: Isabelle Berro-Amadeï
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Isabelle Berro-Amadeï is a Monégasque judge who has served as Minister of Foreign Affairs and Cooperation of Monaco since 2022. On 10 January 2025, she was appointed acting Minister of State after Didier Guillaume was hospitalised. Following Guillaume's death a week later, she retained the position until the appointment of Christophe Mirmand on 21 July 2025.
